title: An unramified trait lift of a pointed etale chart
statement: Let R be a domain DVR, L a scheme, p:L->Spec R and tau:Spec R->L a section of p. Let B be a commutative ring, phi:Spec B->L etale, and y a point of Spec B with phi(y)=tau(m_R). Let rho:R->B satisfy phi;p=Spec rho, and let varpi0 generate m_R. Then there exist a commutative ring A, a domain and DVR, maps delta:R->A and iota:B->A, such that delta is injective, m_A=(delta(varpi0)), iota(rho(varpi0))=delta(varpi0), and Spec iota;phi=Spec delta;tau [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-pc-fibre-product].

proof.text: Form X=Spec B times_L Spec R. Mathlib Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback supplies a point x above y and the closed point from hy. The second projection is etale by base change. Apply etale_trait_stalk to its explicit stalk at x, obtaining domain and DVR instances, injectivity and the maximal-ideal formula.

Define delta and iota as the canonical structural maps to that actual stalk. Mathlib SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk and Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq identify their Spec maps with fromSpecStalk followed by the two pullback projections. Precompose the pullback condition to get the required square. Postcompose that equality with p and use h_rho and h_tau. Faithfulness of Spec gives rho followed by iota = delta, and evaluating at varpi0 gives the coefficient identity.

proof_origin.source: Explicit fibre-product and stalk construction using Mathlib and the proved etale_trait_stalk lemma; follows Stacks Tags 0EYI and 0AP2
